newPageBriefs.contributionAndEvidence: Decision gap: workers know auto-enrollment exists but not the numbers, the dates (statute 2025 vs final regulations after 2027) or their opt-out right. Basis: reported (Treasury SB-0690 and IRC 414A text) plus a small calculated illustration: our internal arithmetic from the stated rule shows a 3% default reaches 10% after seven annual steps; a $60,000 salary equals $1,800 a year at 3% and $6,000 at 10%. Sources checked 2026-11-17, saved verbatim. TD 10061 NOT verified and not to be cited. Counterexample: a worker whose employer is in an exempt category (e.g., a SIMPLE or governmental plan) is not auto-enrolled by this rule; many employers also auto-enroll voluntarily with different defaults. Good-faith interim compliance NOT verified: do not assert.
